New York: a cat-themed collection of art and jewelry closed two Bonhams sales for $1.45 million.

Four Tiffany & Co. cat brooches from Sandy Lerner's collection sold at or above estimate, led by an 18-karat gold pendant brooch at $8,320. Lerner, who co-founded Cisco Systems and founded Urban Decay, built what Bonhams called one of the most significant cat-art collections ever assembled.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
